purpose: Pull the universal Database Toolbox Docker image. One image powers all 22+ database integrations; pulled once before configuring per-database.

examples.scenario: Initial setup before any DB configuration

purpose: Run the Database Toolbox Docker image as an MCP server in STDIO mode against PostgreSQL using the prebuilt config. Requires POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_DATABASE, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD env vars.

flags.name: -i
flags.doc: Interactive (stdin attached) — required for STDIO MCP.

flags.name: -e
flags.doc: Pass an env var into the container.

examples.invocation: POSTGRES_HOST=localhost POSTGRES_DATABASE=mydb POSTGRES_USER=postgres POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret docker run --rm -i -e POSTGRES_HOST -e POSTGRES_DATABASE -e POSTGRES_USER -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/database-toolbox/toolbox/toolbox:latest --prebuilt postgres --stdio
examples.expected_output: MCP server connected; tools/list responds with the postgres tool set
examples.scenario: Quick-start: connect Devin (or any MCP client) to a local PostgreSQL

purpose: Run the Database Toolbox in STDIO mode against a database that requires a custom tools-file YAML (Bigtable, Couchbase, Dgraph, MongoDB, Neo4j, Redis, Redshift, Snowflake, SQLite, TiDB, Valkey).

flags.name: --tools-file
flags.doc: Path inside the container to a tools-config YAML.

flags.name: -v
flags.doc: Bind-mount the YAML into the container.

examples.expected_output: MCP server connected against MongoDB; tool surface defined by the YAML

examples.scenario: Configuring the Slack MCP marketplace integration

purpose: List Slack channel IDs visible to the bot. Used to map channel names to IDs for the Slack MCP marketplace integration. Requires bot scopes channels:read, groups:read, mpim:read, im:read.

examples.expected_output: JSON with channel IDs + names + types
examples.scenario: Configuring the Slack MCP integration's channel filter

purpose: Enable a marketplace MCP server for the org. For 1-click servers, just click Enable. For configured servers, provide credentials/headers in the form first.

examples.invocation: Settings > MCP Marketplace > Datadog > Enable; provide DD-API-KEY + DD-APPLICATION-KEY headers
examples.expected_output: Datadog MCP available in next sessions
examples.scenario: Connecting Datadog to Devin via MCP

command: [UI] Settings > MCP Marketplace > Add Your Own
purpose: Configure a custom MCP server. Form-driven: name, optional icon, description, transport (STDIO/SSE/HTTP), transport-specific config. Save, then click 'Test listing tools' to verify connectivity.

examples.invocation: Settings > MCP Marketplace > Add Your Own > Name='Internal API Gateway', Transport=HTTP, Server URL=https://gw.acme.com/mcp, Auth=Bearer xxx
examples.expected_output: Server saved; click 'Test listing tools' to validate
examples.scenario: Connecting an internal API as an MCP server

command: [UI] Settings > MCP Marketplace > <server> > Test listing tools
purpose: Spin up an isolated test environment, connect to the MCP server, and discover tools via tools/list. Disabled until the config is saved. Failures categorize as connectivity / authentication / timeout.

examples.invocation: Click 'Test listing tools' on a saved custom MCP server
examples.expected_output: Either: tool list rendered, or error message indicating which class of failure
examples.scenario: Validating a custom MCP server during setup

purpose: Generic shape for a custom STDIO MCP server. The 'command' is a launcher (npx/uvx/docker); 'args' is the command-line arg list; 'env' carries the secrets/config the server reads.

flags.name: Environment Variables
flags.doc: Env vars set in the server's process.
